Any reason we're duplicating these probes?  These are regex if you really want to support both capitalizations of nvidia, but in reality there should be only one.

It looks like on the gb200 io board we've ended up observing multiple different variants.  See nvidia_gb200_io_board.json:

        "xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME': 'P4768', 'BOARD_MANUFACTURER': 'NVIDIA'})",
        "OR",
        "xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME': 'ConnectX-7 400GE 2P NIC', 'BOARD_MANUFACTURER': 'Nvidia'})",
        "OR",
        "xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME': '2x ConnectX-7 Mezz', 'BOARD_MANUFACTURER': 'Nvidia'})"

Can someone from nvidia give a solid answer on which one we're going to see?  Otherwise we can delete one of them after we get some of our systems fully built.

My point was mostly that you can do this same thing with:

    "xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME': '(ConnectX-7 400GE 2P NIC)|(P4768)|(2x ConnectX-7 Mezz)', 'BOARD_MANUFACTURER': '(Nvidia)|(NVIDIA)'})"


no need to get fancy.  I can go try to hunt down the "right" name, but I think just a quick simplification is all this PR needs.
Done
Update BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME from "2x ConnectX-8 GB300 Mezz" to "ConnectX-8".
You've used relative bus numbers here.  I think this is what you need on the GB300 config.
Done
This does not seem as a complete enough BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME.  CX-8 is a NIC.  You've now matched on NICs for a particular IO expander board.

Originally, during EVT, the name was "2x ConnectX-8 GB300 Mezz", but in DVT it changed to "ConnectX-8 800GE 2P NIC".
To support both EVT and DVT, we had used the more generic name "ConnectX-8".
Now it has been updated to "ConnectX-8 800GE 2P NIC" to reflect the actual FRU content.
Done
Add OR condition to support both EVT and DVT BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME.
